[[The Sulfurous Wastes]] | henchman = y | hero armorer = y | merchant = y | records keeper = y | storage = y | pic1 = [[Image:Remains of Sahlahja world map.jpg|196px]] | pic1-text = On the world map | pic2 = [[Image:Remains of Sahlahja inside.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = A view inside }} {{Quotation|game|This ruined and crumbling city was once the home of [[Sahlahjar the Dead|King Sahlahjar]], the last of his line. Sahlahjar's father had resisted [[Palawa Joko]] for years, but with Lord Joko's armies advancing, Sahlahjar gave into his fears and cut a deal with the undead lord. Shortly after, Sahlahjar's citadel was overrun by Joko's undead army. The unlucky king was gutted and his remains animated as Joko's court jester. Sahlahjar remains bitter about this.}} [[Remains of Sahlahja (outpost)|Remains of Sahlahja]] are the ruins of an ancient border kingom's capital city. It is still haunted by some of its previous inhabitants, including its last king. ==Getting there== The party will end up in this outpost upon completion of the [[Gate of Desolation]] mission. It is located in the middle along the northern edge of [[the Sulfurous Wastes]]. It is actually possible to reach this location (via the northern entrance) without completing the aforementioned mission, and thus without the aid of [[Junundu]]; this can be difficult to execute for inexperienced players however.
